title: BEST MOB FARM In Minecraft Tutorial - EASY - 89,000/HR!
description:
In This Tutorial I Will Show you how to make The best mob farm that you can build In Minecraft a mob farm that is based on a new method, is much cheaper, and faster and it will have specific mob drops that make this farm so special!

📝Important Details About This Farm :
📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +20,000 ~ +89,000 ( Drops )
 Drops Per Hour! 
📚This farm is non redstone circuit which makes this farm the best choice for beginners but even with redstone this farm is faster and the rate is extremely fast!
📚This farm is so fast and I highly recommend this farm to beginners.
📚This module uses a boat to activate and trigger it has a clock but the setup has a specific amount of delay to be activated and it does not even use dispenser
📚This farm exactly uses a similar method to stacking raid farms to push mobs into the chambers except this one will be pushed at once this makes the farm so fast because if we think about it the water-pushing method will take time to push mobs to the chamber!
